cohort: The study included 75 parturients with severe preeclampsia and 75 parturients with normotension, all scheduled for cesarean delivery under combined spinal-epidural anesthesia.
finding: Severe preeclamptic parturients required a 34% reduction of the ED50 of phenylephrine dose compared with normotensive parturients for the treatment of spinal anesthesia-induced hypotension.
